periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, angled approximately 45 degrees downward from the posterior towards the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with a vertical axis approximately twice the length of the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward taper extending the lower margin well below the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Flat U-shape with a largely straight posterior boundary relative to the torso length.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brownish-yellow staining visible across the white pelage of the lumbar and hindquarter regions.
